principles: use three substantive lessons per unit with lesson-3 independent production or mediation
strengthen pragmatic interaction, practical problem solving, short connected narration and supported recommendations
recycle reported information, realistic conditions, sequencing and reasons across concrete B1 domains
avoid B2 counterfactuals, dense concession, inferential calibration, multi-source synthesis and sustained abstract argumentation
keep Persian support concise, natural and action-oriented
